rules.validationPoint: adapter before GraphDigestV2 input construction; pure module repeats structural path checks
rules.hostResponsibility: host may bind registry/project identity later, but cannot repair a path mismatch
rules.prohibitedShortcut: node label, relation id, or string similarity is not byte-source proof

rules.validationPoint: adapter recomputes the expected code-unit position from the frozen source text and checks the token span
rules.hostResponsibility: none; host observation cannot change a static source span
rules.prohibitedShortcut: same numeric value without checking the source bytes is insufficient

trustedEvidence: byte offset recomputation before decoding normalization
rules.validationPoint: adapter source snapshot validator; no LF/CRLF or Unicode normalization
rules.hostResponsibility: none; platform-specific offset drift is a source snapshot failure, not a host proof
rules.prohibitedShortcut: charOffset equality or relation id equality cannot substitute for byte offset equality

rules.claim: mapping.sourceAnchorRelationId selects one reads/source-proven edge from a file node to the exact token-use node
rules.validationPoint: adapter relation index and immutable source path check; pure module validates endpoint/kind/certainty/equality
rules.hostResponsibility: host can attest the analyzer build, not invent an absent anchor
rules.prohibitedShortcut: node names and endpoint strings alone do not prove an anchor

statusRules.missingMapping: preserve graph and unresolved diagnostics, return unavailable; do not emit a trusted mapping
statusRules.duplicateMapping: reject; one sourceRef, graphNodeId, and anchor cannot be mapped twice
statusRules.conflictingMapping: reject; differing path/offset/anchor/sourceIdentity is not merged
statusRules.untrustedProjectId: unavailable even when pure content validation succeeds
